extracted.intended_audience: journalists who report on violence, conflict, tragedy (and journalism educators/mental-health collaborators)
extracted.subtask_description: Guidance for journalists on producing responsible, effective news coverage of violence, conflict and tragedy, emphasizing ethics, skill, and use of interdisciplinary resources. Relevant for reporters, editors, and educators working with traumatic-topic coverage.

rubrics_metrics.name: Informed, innovative and ethical news reporting
rubrics_metrics.description: The Dart Center is 'dedicated to informed, innovative and ethical news reporting on violence, conflict and tragedy.'
rubrics_metrics.guidance: This groups three core qualities reporters should aim for when covering traumatic topics: being well-informed about context and facts; using innovative approaches to storytelling; and following ethical practices that respect victims and communities.

rubrics_metrics.name: Effective reporting on traumatic events requires knowledge, skill and support
rubrics_metrics.description: Whether the topic is street crime, family violence, natural disaster, war or human rights, 'effective news reporting on traumatic events demands knowledge, skill and support.'
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Reporters should possess subject-matter knowledge and reporting skills and have access to institutional and peer support systems (e.g., editorial guidance, mental-health resources) to handle the complexities and emotional toll of traumatic coverage.

rubrics_metrics.name: Draw on a global, interdisciplinary network of experts
rubrics_metrics.description: The Dart Center provides resources 'drawing on a global, interdisciplinary network of news professionals, mental health experts, educators and researchers.'
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Good practice includes consulting and collaborating with journalists experienced in trauma reporting, mental-health professionals for safety and ethical considerations, educators for training, and researchers for evidence-based approaches; use these resources to inform reporting decisions and newsroom policies.
